question: Who among the following became the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pushkar Singh Dhami.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pushkar Singh Dhami** was elected as the **Chief Minister of Uttarakhand **on **4th July 2021.**
 
• He succeeded **Tirath Singh Rawat **who resigned from the post after serving for** just four months.**
 
• Prior to becoming the Chief Minister, Pushkar Singh Dhami was a **Member of Legislative Assembly** (MLA) from **Khatima constituency** in **Uttarakhand.**
 
• Dhami is the** youngest **Chief Minister of Uttarakhand and is considered to be a close aide of former Chief Minister** Trivendra Singh Rawat.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhuwan Chandra Khanduri** is a retired Indian Army officer and politician who served as the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand from **2007 to 2009.**
 
• **Trivendra Singh Rawat** was the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand from **2017 to 2021.**
 
• **Tirath Singh Rawat **served as the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand for a brief period of four months from **March 2021 to July 2021**.
 
• In India, each of the **28 states **and occasionally a union territory has an** elected chief minister** serving as **head of state.**
